title: Vibrant Crunchy Japanese Noodles Ramen Tonkotsu
description: A low-fat friendly and crunchy Japanese noodle dish featuring rich tonkotsu broth and topped with various textures, perfect for a sick day pick-me-up.

ingredients.name: pork bones
ingredients.notes: you can also use chicken bones

instructions: In a large pot, heat the oil over medium heat and saute the sliced onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and sliced ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pork bones to the pot and pour in enough water to cover the bones.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 4 hours.
Strain the broth through a fine mesh sieve into a clean pot and discard the solids.
Add the noodles to the pot and cook according to the package instructions.
In a small pan, toast the sesame seeds over medium heat until they are fragrant.
To assemble the dish, place some noodles in a bowl, then ladle the hot broth over the noodles.
Top the noodles with chopped green onions, bean sprouts, and toasted sesame seeds.
Drizzle the soy sauce over the top of the dish and serve immediately.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
